mask_policy: targetable main-text units only; at least one visible main-text context unit remains; damage, ligatures and annotations protected as targets
unit_of_length: one atomic source unit, not a Unicode code point or native subword
validation_use: checkpoint selection and hyperparameter tuning only
test_use: final comparison after model and hyperparameter decisions
validation_rule: exactly one fixed legal contiguous gap per validation source per available length
validation_aggregation: equal-weight mean of scores for the five actual gap lengths
training_boundary_span_policy: length-1..5 spans may touch either sequence boundary; at least one source unit remains context
expert_evidence_rule: whole original bracket region; source normalized context equals representative context; no atomic cut

frequency_bands.source: Eligible single-unit prediction positions in training
